prompts.name: hype-hk
prompts.prompt: Create one polished landscape 16:9 title card, full bleed graphic artwork, crisp geometric vector-like design and impeccable bold modern grotesk typography. HYPE.HK visual language: angular square spiral/maze motif, purple-to-pink accents, lavender and mint on near-black. Sophisticated Swiss typographic composition with large clearly readable hub name, generous negative space, geometrical pattern taking up right half and integrating subtly behind text. Flat shapes, sharp edges, selective gradients, no photography, no 3D, no mockup, no extra slogans or invented text. Each card part of cohesive family. Exact title: 'HYPE.HK'. Giant white title left lower-middle. Right: oversized interlocking square spirals and concentric right-angle paths, violet to hot pink to coral bands, tiny mint square accents. Deep black-purple background. Make geometry architectural, bold, clean.
